Name: Valley Girls - i18n Patch (Content Patcher)
Author: Jybee
Description:
This patch transforms Valley Girls dialogues/events to use i18n (Content Patcher), without redistributing the original content.
[b]Result:[/b] the mod becomes properly translatable (EN by default via i18n/default.json).

• Requirements: SMAPI 4.x, Content Patcher, original ‘Valley Girls’ mod.
• Installation: Replace the original files from the Valley Girls mod with the files from this patch.
• Scope: Dialogue + Events (replacements with {{i18n:...}} tokens).
• No assets (portraits, sprites) are included.
• Patch created on Valley Girl version 3.6.0

------------

[b]Purpose:[/b] to convert all dialogues/events in the Valley Girls mod to i18n format (Content Patcher keys), without redistributing assets.
[b]Usefulness:[/b] to make the mod properly translatable (and maintainable) into any language.

[b]🌟 Why this patch?[/b]

[list]
[*][b] Clean translations:[/b] texts are no longer ‘hard-coded’ in event/dialogue JSON files; they go through i18n keys ({{i18n:...}}).
[*][b] Easy maintenance:[/b] when Valley Girls is updated, you just need to add/modify keys (instead of searching for bits of sentences in long files).
[*][b] Compatibility:[/b] English is still provided via i18n/default.json (fallback CP). Language packs can be added without affecting the mod's logic.
[*][b] Security:[/b] this patch only changes text and does not contain any assets (no images/portraits/sounds).
[/list]
[b]🎯 Theme & objective[/b]

[list]
[*][b] Theme:[/b] Valley Girls focused on additional dialogue/events.
[*][b] Objective:[/b] to expose all textual content via consistent and stable i18n keys (e.g. Haley.Summer.Tue.001, Choice.Night.Yes).
[*][b] Scope:[/b]
[/list] ﻿Dialogue of the NPCs concerned (Data/Dialogue/*, Characters/Dialogue/* as appropriate),
﻿Events (Data/Events/*, including MarriageEvents).

[b]✅ What the patch actually does[/b]

[list]
[*] Replaces text values with i18n tokens ({{i18n:Key}}).
[*] Provides an i18n/default.json file (English) containing 1 key per line/fragment.
[*] Leaves the logic (conditions, TextOperations, loading orders) intact.
[/list][b]📦 Patch contents (tree structure)[/b]

[code][CP] VALLEY GIRLS/
├─ content.json
├─ i18n/
│ └─ default.json
└─ assets/Jsons/Events/
├─ Events.json
└─ MarriageEvents.json
[/code]
Note: Files located in assets/Jsons/Events/ are only used for text targeting/patching and do not contain any visual elements.

[b]🔧 Prerequisites[/b]

[list]
[*] Stardew Valley 1.6.x
[*] SMAPI 4.x
[*] ContentPatcher
[*] Original ‘Valley Girls’ mod (required)
[/list]
[b]🧭 Installation & loading order[/b]

[list]
[*] Install Valley Girls (original mod).
[*] Unzip this patch into the Mods/ folder.
[*] Launch the game via SMAPI.
[*] The patch is designed to load after the original mod (i18n replacements apply automatically).
[/list]
[b]🌍 Usage & languages[/b]

[list]
[*] By default, the game will use English from i18n/default.json.
[*] For another language, install a separate language pack.
[*] Language packs can condition their changes with ‘Language’: ‘fr’ (or other), so as not to overwrite the English.
[*] Example : i18n/fr.json
[/list][b]🤝 Compatibility[/b]

[list]
[*] Text scope only (Dialogue/Events).
[*] Compatible with other mods as long as they do not overwrite the exact same lines.
[*] If another mod modifies the same entry, leave this patch after it in the load order (or use the When/After conditions on the CP side).
[/list]
[b]🧪 Verification & Troubleshooting[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]SMAPI report:[/b] in-game, open the SMAPI console (or look at smapi-latest.txt) to confirm that this mod's CP patches are applying.
[*][b] Conflicts:[/b] if some lines remain in English even though you have a VF installed, check:
[*] ﻿ ﻿that the i18n pack (this mod) is present,
[*] ﻿ ﻿that the translation is after this patch,
[*] ﻿ ﻿the game language (en to apply the conditional EN),
[*] ﻿ ﻿mods that patch the same targets.
[*] [b]Saves:[/b] this patch does not affect saves (text only). You can install/uninstall it without risk of corruption.
[/list]
